entries.title: Joshua 19:1
segments: Within the inheritance of--Judah; on the survey of the whole land, it was found that what had been allotted to Judah was too large for one tribe,

; the south-west part of it was therefore allotted to Simeon.  His inheritance was bounded on the north and east by that of Judah, on the south by the desert of Zin, and on the west by the land of the Philistines.

entries.title: Joshua 19:2
segments:
vv 2-9. 
 
These places were within the district mentioned in note

entries.title: Joshua 19:9
segments: If through mistake persons have obtained more than rightfully belongs to them, they should, on its being known, promptly and cheerfully restore it.

entries.title: Joshua 19:10
segments: The children of Zebulun; their inheritance was bounded on the east by the river Jordan and the sea of Galilee, on the north by Asher and Naphtali, on the west by Asher and Manasseh, and on the south by Issachar.

entries.title: Joshua 19:11
segments:
vv 11-15. 
 
These places were in or on the borders of the territory mentioned in note on

entries.title: Joshua 19:17
segments: The children of Issachar; their inheritance was bounded on the east by the Jordan, on the north by Zebulun, on the west by Manasseh, and on the south by Ephraim.

entries.title: Joshua 19:18
segments:
vv 18-22. 
 
Places in or on the borders of Issachar.

entries.title: Joshua 19:24
segments: The children of Asher; their inheritance was in the north-west part of the country towards Tyre, and was bounded on the east by Naphtali, on the north by Syria, on the west by Phenicia, and on the south by Zebulun.

entries.title: Joshua 19:25
segments:
vv 25-31. 
 
Places in or on the borders of Asher.

entries.title: Joshua 19:32
segments: The children of Naphtali; their inheritance was in the north-east part of the country, and was bounded on the east by the Jordan, on the north by Syria, on the west by Asher, and on the south by Zebulun and the sea of Galilee.

entries.title: Joshua 19:33
segments:
vv 33-38. 
 
Places in, or on the borders of Naphtali. 
 
  Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising; we are probably to understand the cities of Jair in the land of Gilead east of the Jordan,
.  Though these properly belonged to the half-tribe of Manasseh, they might well have been called "Judah upon Jordan," because Jair was a descendant of Judah.

entries.title: Joshua 19:40
segments:
The children of Dan; their inheritance was bounded by Benjamin on the east, by Ephraim on the north, by the Mediterranean and the Philistines on the west, and by Judah on the south. 
 
Although the land of Canaan was divided by lot among the several tribes of Israel, yet their inheritance and condition were such as was predicted, and as it was beforehand certain that they would be.

entries.title: Joshua 19:41
segments:
vv 41-46. 
 
Places in or on the borders of Dan.

entries.title: Joshua 19:47
segments: Leshem; the same as Laish, a city near the foot of mount Lebanon and the sources of the Jordan.

entries.title: Joshua 19:50
segments: Timnath-serah; a place in the hilly country of the tribe of Ephraim, called, in

, Timnath-heres.  It was here that Joshua lived, died, and was buried. 
 
They who have been eminent benefactors of their fellow men, should be remembered with gratitude, honored, and if need by, provided for, by those whose interests have been secured by their sacrifices and efforts.
